overview_description.description:
Clever operates as a single sign-on platform for K-12 education. It unlocks a wealth of digital learning, so teachers can meet each student where they are. Clever brings all applications into one secure portal and provides single sign-on for everyone in the district.

It was founded in 2012 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Clever is a digital learning platform designed for K12 schools and used by 22 million students and teachers.

product.name: Clever Portal
product.description: A single sign-on platform providing students, teachers, and staff secure access to all digital learning resources with personalized portals and usage analytics.

product.name: Secure Sync Rostering
product.description: Automated synchronization of student and staff data from information systems to educational applications for accurate account provisioning and rostering.

product.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
product.description: A unified login system that allows users to access multiple educational applications and resources with one set of credentials.

product.name: Clever Badges
product.description: A login method using QR code badges that allows young students to quickly and securely access their digital learning accounts without typing passwords.

product.name: Identity Management
product.description: A system for managing digital identities of students, teachers, and staff to secure access and control data sharing across educational applications.

product.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
product.description: An additional security layer for user logins that verifies identity using multiple methods without requiring extra devices.
